owner_observation: Relayed by the coordinator (2026-10-18): the owner saw no notification over the launcher ("I haven't seen one"); they were not sure they were watching at that moment. The title crashed about 4 s after the send (the toast). A watched re-run with no toast (build bf7da101b4e7cbd9) did not run: ps5vkctl stopped answering first.
stick_note: The stick was empty and GPT-partitioned during this run (the coordinator, 2026-10-18): the PS5 did not mount it, so /mnt/usb0 was a tmpfs placeholder. Not a console limit: after it was made MBR + exFAT with mihawkos/probe.bin, probe-install-usb-2026-10-18-03 and probe-usb-wine-2026-10-18-02 read it.
